Definition: Target-neutral handoff contract for selected local shell or solid FEA review.
A specialized downstream artifact referencing global model context, selected entities, load/result bases, units, assumptions, warnings, hashes, and provenance.
The normal global analysis model retained as the reference baseline.
The global solver/analysis whose normal envelope shape diagnostics follow.
Labels that route attention only; they do not certify, approve, seal, authenticate, or determine code compliance.
Explicit naming of coordinate, force, moment, displacement, rotation, stress, and temperature units; conversion authority remains with the units contract.
Metadata required for global-to-local transfer; absence makes the package incomplete.
Diagnostic record shape: code, class, severity, source, affected object, message, remediation, and provenance.
Label requiring a competent human to review model context, assumptions, diagnostics, limitations, and downstream local-analysis setup on every guidance assessment.
